ownRead.statement:
**Current repository edition:** RRG v0.3.2 — forces rationale, 2026-10-07
**Author:** Vasyl Hryha
**Predecessor:** RRG v0.3.1 — relation to existing work, 2026-10-07; seal `2c2ab0fa3ce4c172276a9247e3a207061e7fef6f7a40d583a67d6f504e390408`.

This is an explicitly directed source revision. It adds the exact author-approved forces rationale in 01 §7.3, motivating the speculative hypothesis without adding evidence. The v0.3.1 related-work comparison, common-question answer and reading path are retained unchanged. The authoritative §4.5 semantic record (affected files/claims, before/after, support, permission and dependents) is CHANGELOG change `RRG-2026-10-07-V032-FORCES-RATIONALE` under the existing R4 §0.3/§4.5 revision procedure.

## Authority order

1. `00_LOCKED_CORE.md` remains the minimal normative core, byte-for-byte unchanged. Its v0.2 heading identifies the retained core, not the whole package's edition.
2. `05_CHANGE_CONTROL.md` remains the unchanged core-change protocol. No failing definition or core revision is proposed.
3. `01_world_explanation.md` is the v0.3.2 main plain-language explanation, retaining the v0.3 clarifications. Its clarifications explain the core or label downstream hypotheses. `02_scientific_framework.md` and `03_mathematical_core.md` retain their arguments and candidate models; 02 §17 now compares related work. The retained cross-references distinguish latent interaction channels from the speculative origin of forces.
4. `04_recursive_background_generation.md` retains the audited argument with minimal v0.3 links and labelled extensions. README and 08 supply the entry point, current hypothesis status and common-question route. Optional mathematics (05), evidence cases (06) and the dated audit (07) remain carried-forward work; their old dates do not report a v0.3 audit.
5. `sources.json` carries unchanged evidence cases and existing reading records, plus five related-work bibliographic records with v0.3.2 metadata. These records are supplementary and do not establish RRG. `foundations/` and `checks/` are unchanged supporting provenance/audit material, not new current definitions or new execution results.

## Predecessor provenance

The complete v0.3.1 predecessor is preserved byte-for-byte under `research/history/repository-current-v0.3.1-2026-10-07/`. The complete v0.3 predecessor is preserved byte-for-byte under `research/history/repository-current-v0.3-2026-10-07/`. The complete v0.2.1 repository current promoted on 5 October 2026 is preserved byte-for-byte under `research/history/repository-current-v0.2.1-promoted-2026-10-05/`. The earlier repository set remains at `research/history/repository-current-2026-10-01/`; audited package history and supplied ZIPs remain untouched. These are historical editions, not competing current sources.

The inventory seal and manifest hash in `config/research-source.json` identify the resulting edition. Its revision record identifies the predecessor seal and exact affected membership. A new identity never upgrades an old approval.

## Website consequences

Source-bound website bindings are updated mechanically to the new exact source edition and excerpts. Authored website text is outside this source-revision batch. Previous source-dependent website decisions remain issued evidence and become stale; missing decisions remain pending. This revision grants no website fidelity acceptance, scientific certification, licence, commit, public publication or deployment authorization. The website must follow the revised sources in its separate work.

Actual checks and REVIEW_READY status are recorded in `docs/evidence/source-revision-v0.3.2/receipt.md`; resulting edition/hash and predecessor provenance are sealed externally in `config/research-source.json` and `research/publication/source-revision-v0.3.2.json`. This avoids circular self-hashes. Independent review is pending.
ownRead.plainLanguage:
This is the current authority record for the v0.3.2 forces-rationale revision. The minimal core and its change-control protocol remain byte-identical. The new rationale motivates the speculative forces hypothesis without adding evidence. The framework’s seven comparisons, world explanation and retained claim coverage coexist with the carried-forward optional calculations, evidence catalogue and dated audit.

The exact v0.3.1, v0.3 and v0.2.1 predecessors and older foundation snapshots are preserved as history. A new source identity does not renew an old website approval or establish new scientific evidence. The source record requires a separate website fidelity review; the reading decisions describe that review, while [Cite](/cite/) identifies this website selection and [Rights](/legal/) records permissions. Original downloads retain exact source bytes.
